paragraphs.source_en: Yashirō stared at O-Mitsu with wide eyes, utterly astonished. Her words seemed to be an admonition meant for him. Young Yashirō had concerned himself only with pitying others, never realizing his own wretchedness or the sorrow of human existence; in truth, he was no different from anyone else. O-Mitsu seemed to be telling him that only by understanding this could one feel true compassion.
